To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) The user needs analysis is a key stage in the design process, and the methods used to conduct the analysis are the key tools for the designer to understand and identify the needs of the target users and the context of use of the product to be designed; (2) The user needs are not static, they change over time, and the analysis methods have to be flexible enough to adapt to this change; (3) The user needs cannot be understood without the context of use; and
the user needs analysis is an important step in the design process.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a user-centered design approach for web design and development.
how the web can be made to be more usable, and how the usability of the web can be measured and improved.
the design of a web-based information system which is used by the employees of a company to manage their work and to interact with the other employees.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
social research tools are essential for a user-centered design approach and that they should be used from the beginning of the design process.
the user-centered approach in web design is a process which involves the designer, the users and the product itself.
usability is not a final result of the design process but an embedded part of it.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the usability concept should be rethought in order to move from the traditional usability approach towards a more user-centered approach.
usability can be achieved only if the design process is user-centered.
the social research methods used in the user needs analysis phase of the design process can be seen as a tool for understanding the user, the user’s needs, and the user’s context.
The main takeaway from our work is that
social research methods used in user needs analysis can be very effective in moving the traditional usability approach towards a user-centered design approach.
user-centered design approach requires a deep understanding of the people involved in a specific context and that the use of social research methods can support this understanding.
user-centered design is a continuous process of interaction between the user and the design product.
